report.title: Locator expected to be visible but was not
report.summary: The 'Account #: ' field is not visible on the Bill Pay page. This is a critical issue as it affects the user's ability to view account information.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Log in to the ParaBank website as a registered user.
2. Navigate to the Bill Pay page.
3. Verify that the 'Account #: ' field is not visible.
report.expected: The 'Account #: ' field should be visible on the Bill Pay page.
report.actual: Locator expected to be visible but was not: Locator expected to be visible
evidence: Error: strict mode violation: get_by_text("Account #:") resolved to 3 elements:
report.suspected_cause: The page is not rendering the 'Account #: ' field correctly.
report.next_action: Investigate the page's HTML and CSS to determine why the 'Account #: ' field is not visible.
